n: Ask the Lord — not idols — for rain in spring. He makes storm clouds and gives showers and green fields. Baal was supposed to be the storm god; Zechariah insists the true source is the Lord.

f.g: Spring rains (March–April) that ripen the crops.

n: Household idols speak nonsense, fortune-tellers see lies and tell false dreams. So the people wander like sheep without a shepherd.

f.g: Hebrew teraphim — household gods used for divination.

n: God is angry with the bad shepherds (leaders) and will punish the “goats” — the strong who abuse the flock. He will turn Judah into His proud warhorse.

f.g: Leaders or bullies among the flock.

n: From Judah will come the cornerstone, the tent peg, the battle bow, and every ruler. Many see the Messiah in the cornerstone and the peg — a sure support.

f.g: A tent peg — something firm to hang everything on.

n: Judah will be like mighty warriors trampling enemies, fighting because the Lord is with them.

f.w: because the LORD is with them

n: God will strengthen Judah and save Joseph’s house (the northern tribes). He will bring them back as if He had never rejected them. Both kingdoms will be reunited.

f.g: The northern tribes, led by Ephraim and Manasseh.

f.w: as though I had not cast them off

n: Ephraim will be strong and joyful, and their children will see it and rejoice in the Lord.
God will whistle for His people and gather them, for He has redeemed them, and they will multiply as before. A shepherd’s whistle calls the flock home.
God scattered Israel among the nations like seed, but in faraway lands they will remember Him, survive with their children, and return. Scattering becomes sowing.

f.w: I will sow them among the people
they shall remember me in far countries

n: God will bring them back from Egypt and Assyria, filling Gilead and Lebanon until there’s no room left.

f.w: place shall not be found for them

n: As at the Exodus, God will pass through the sea of trouble, strike the waves, and dry up the Nile. Assyria’s pride and Egypt’s rule will fall.

f.w: shall smite the waves in the sea

n: God will strengthen them, and they will walk in His name. Their strength and identity come from Him.

f.w: they shall walk up and down in his name
